name: pi-durable-assistant
description: 基于 Pi Durable 的网页版个人 Agent：断点恢复、记事本、子 Agent、定时计划、任务中心和微信通道

scripts.test: pnpm run build && NODE_ENV=test node --experimental-vm-modules --test packages/*/dist-tests/*.test.js apps/*/dist-tests/*.test.js tests/dist/*.test.js
scripts.start:web: pnpm --filter @assistant/web run build && tsc -b scripts && node .build/scripts/web-server.js
scripts.desktop:package: pnpm --filter @assistant/desktop run build && tsc -b scripts && node .build/scripts/desktop-package.js
